the end-to-end latencies of the fault-tolerance infrastructure for passive, semi-active and active replication are 1) for passive and semi active replication, the latency is determined by the time to send a message, and 2) for active replication, the end-to-end performance is improved by the duplicate suppression mechanism.

the end-to-end delay is determined primarily by the processing time at each node, the token rotation delay, and the message sending time; the end-to-end processing time is dominated by the processing cost of Totem; and the end-to-end message sending time depends on the position of the server on the Totem token ring, the token ring size and the token rotation time.

the performance of a fault-tolerance infrastructure is limited by the group communication protocol, the processing costs of the servers and the client, and that the performance can be improved by using active replication with a sending-side duplicate suppression.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the end-to-end delay of a fault-tolerance infrastructure can be significantly improved if the position of the server on the Totem token ring is carefully chosen.
the fault-tolerance of a system should not be achieved at the expense of its performance.
the fault-tolerantsystem is not as fast as a fault-free system, and that active replication is the most advantageous among the three replication schemes for the fault-toler-ant system.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the end-to-end performance of a fault-tolerance infrastructure is determined primarily by the underlying group communication protocol, and the performance of the group communication protocol is determined primarily by how the server replicas are positioned on the ring and the token rotation time of the protocol.
the end-to-end delay in sending a message is not the only factor that determines the performance of a fault-tolerance infrastructure.
, in order to achieve high performance, the position of server replicas must be considered carefully, and the sending-side duplicate suppression must be implemented.
